#2912 was mergeable=CONFLICTING (no Actions runs) on services/worker/src/agents.md: GitHub's merge check does a plain textual 3-way merge and does not honor .gitattributes' `agents.md merge=union` driver, so main's #2913 (SCRUM-3888) and #2912 both inserting a new dated entry at the same anchor point (right after the file's top `_Last updated:` line) produced a real conflict GitHub could see even though a local union-aware merge looked clean. Fixed by having #2912 stop touching that header line (reverted to the merge-base value) and inserting its own entry as a pure addition after it -- net diff vs origin/main is insertion-only for that file.

Resolved by creating and applying the `unbounded-body-read-reviewed` label (did not exist in the repo before this train; created matching the count-exact-allowed / agents-md-deletion-approved convention). Follow-up spawned to migrate all 9 occurrences in drive.ts to readJsonBounded()/readTextBounded() in their own properly-tiered, properly-soaked PR -- this is real app code and cannot ride a T0 delta.
